description:
Partner with The Soccer Archive

The Soccer Archive is a leading destination for authentic vintage football shirts, classic kits and football memorabilia from clubs and national teams around the world.

We work with creators, collectors and football communities who share our passion for football culture. From iconic 90s classics and rare international shirts to everyday archive staples, we add new arrivals daily and ship worldwide.

Whether your audience loves football, fashion, travel or sportswear, we're looking for genuine partners who can introduce The Soccer Archive to fellow supporters and collectors.

Why join?

  • Competitive commission on every successful referral
  • New arrivals added daily
  • Authentic vintage football shirts and memorabilia
  • Worldwide shipping
  • Dedicated affiliate support
  • Exclusive campaigns and season promotions

We're looking to partner with:

  • Football content creators
  • Vintage football shirt collectors
  • Football YouTubers & TikTok/Instagram creators
  • Football history pages
  • Groundhoppers & stadium travellers
  • Podcasts & newsletters
  • Sportswear & streetwear creators
  • Football websites and blogs

Why creators love working with us

We launch new products every day, giving partners fresh content to share throughout the year. You'll also receive campaign updates, product recommendations and support from our in-house team.

What your audience will love:

  • Authentic vintage football shirts from clubs and national teams worldwide
  • Fresh products added every day
  • Rare and hard-to-find archive pieces
  • Worldwide delivery
  • Trusted by collectors and football fans around the globe


About our brand and products

The Soccer Archive is a leading destination for authentic vintage football shirts, classic kits and football memorabilia from clubs and national teams around the world. With stores in Soho, London and Milano, alongside our online store, we serve a global community of collectors, supporters and football fans. Our collection features iconic designs, rare finds and everyday archive staples, with new arrivals added daily.

What makes us different

Unlike traditional football retailers, every product is carefully selected with a focus on authenticity, quality and football heritage. We stock genuine vintage shirts from hundreds of clubs and national teams, with fresh products added every day, giving creators new stories and products to share throughout the year.

How affiliates can earn

As a partner, you'll earn commission on every successful order placed through your unique referral link or discount code. The more customers you introduce, the more you can earn. We also run seasonal campaigns, exclusive promotions and product launches throughout the year, creating regular opportunities to generate sales and commissions.

How to promote us

Share your unique referral link through social media, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, blogs, newsletters, podcasts or your website. Whether you're showcasing your football shirt collection, creating matchday content, discussing football history or styling vintage sportswear, there are plenty of natural ways to introduce The Soccer Archive to your audience.

Other information

We're looking to build long-term partnerships with creators who genuinely love football culture. Whether you're an established publisher or just starting to grow your community, we'd love to work with people who create authentic, engaging content. Our team is always on hand to support partners with campaign ideas, product recommendations and creative opportunities. With new arrivals added daily, there's always something fresh for your audience to discover.
payout_period: Monthly, on the 15th of each month.
